<!-- Generated by scripts/cli_reference.py from the help of the huron CLI. After you change the help, run `uv run python scripts/cli_reference.py`. -->

Show the details of one organization, catalog, namespace, collection or schema.

Panel: [Catalog](/docs/reference/cli/panels/catalog/).

## Usage

```text
huron describe [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command                                                   | Description                                                 |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| [`huron describe org`](#huron-describe-org)               | Show one organization.                                      |
| [`huron describe catalog`](#huron-describe-catalog)       | Show one catalog. The default is the current catalog.       |
| [`huron describe namespace`](#huron-describe-namespace)   | Show one namespace.                                         |
| [`huron describe collection`](#huron-describe-collection) | Show one collection. The default is the current collection. |
| [`huron describe schema`](#huron-describe-schema)         | Show one schema entry, or its resolved document.            |

## `huron describe org`

Show one organization.

```text
huron describe org [OPTIONS] NAME
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description |
| -------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `NAME`   | str  | Required.   |

## `huron describe catalog`

Show one catalog. The default is the current catalog.

```text
huron describe catalog [OPTIONS] [NAME]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Type | Description                         |
| -------- | ---- | ----------------------------------- |
| `NAME`   | str  | The default is the current catalog. |

## `huron describe namespace`

Show one namespace.

```text
huron describe namespace [OPTIONS] IDENTIFIER
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                             |
| ------------ | ---- | --------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | `catalog.namespace[.child…]`. Required. |

## `huron describe collection`

Show one collection. The default is the current collection.

```text
huron describe collection [OPTIONS] [IDENTIFIER]
```

### Arguments

| Argument     | Type | Description                            |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------- |
| `IDENTIFIER` | str  | The default is the current collection. |

## `huron describe schema`

Show one schema entry, or its resolved document.

```text
huron describe schema [OPTIONS] SCHEMA_ID
```

### Arguments

| Argument    | Type | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `SCHEMA_ID` | str  | Required.   |

### Options

| Option                         | Type    | Default       | Description                                                |
| ------------------------------ | ------- | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--resolved` / `--no-resolved` | boolean | `no-resolved` | Show the schema combined with all schemas that it extends. |
